subject_session: Achilles-10252013, Achilles-11012013, Cicero-09012014, Gatsby-08022013 (4 sessions, 3 rats)

headline_stat.name: fraction of running units significantly theta-locked (circular-shift null)

stated_limitation: Two caveats: the absolute preferred phase depends on where the channel sits relative to the CA1 layers, since theta reverses phase across the pyramidal layer and the fissure, so only within-session phase structure should be compared; and locking is measured here irrespective of position on the track, so it averages over any phase precession within place fields and therefore understates pyramidal-cell locking.

justification.dataset: DANDI 000044 (Grosmark & Buzsáki dorsal CA1, freely moving rats on a linear track) is the canonical dataset for hippocampal theta phase entrainment.
justification.handling: Real LFP and spikes streamed per-channel from the archive with correct 1250 Hz rate, cell-type/location metadata, explicit run-speed epoching, state restriction to sleep blocks, and a ≥100-spike inclusion criterion.
justification.analysis: Proper circular statistics (MRL, preferred phase) tested against a spike-count- and burst-preserving circular-shift null, with the Rayleigh test explicitly flagged as anti-conservative, Bonferroni correction, spike-count matching, frequency-band specificity, and amplitude split.
justification.correctness: All reported numbers (377 units, 307 locked, 265 Bonferroni-Rayleigh, median MRL 0.102 vs 0.173, Mann-Whitney p=2.3e-10, 97% vs 78%) reproduce exactly from the committed CSV and are internally consistent with the figures.
justification.figures: Figures are clearly labeled with units and sample sizes; example units show unambiguous locking and the population map visibly demonstrates phase tiling in run/REM versus shared-phase population bursts in non-REM.
justification.honesty: The write-up is proportionate, treats non-REM as a partial rather than clean control and explains the confound, flags the Rayleigh test as anti-conservative, and names channel-layer phase-reversal and position-averaging caveats explicitly.
justification.verdict: This is publication-adjacent work: canonical dataset, correct controls, fully reproducing numbers, and a candid, well-calibrated write-up that I would accept from a rotation student without hesitation.
